## AI Customer Support Email Automation v1.0
Gmail -> normalize -> dedupe -> classify -> RAG (Pinecone) -> generate -> validate -> threaded reply OR human escalation -> audit.

**Fail closed:** any uncertainty escalates; no automated reply is sent.

See docs/setup-guide.md.

## Credentials (n8n credential store only)
- Gmail OAuth2 (scopes: gmail.readonly + gmail.modify + gmail.send; gmail.compose optional)
- OpenAI API (openAiApi)
- Pinecone: Header Auth credential, header name `Api-Key`

Never paste keys into nodes, prompts or Code.

## 00 - Config is the ONLY place for thresholds and client values
OPEN DECISIONS (confirm before go-live): mailbox + trigger criteria, non-support action, escalation destination, Pinecone namespace/metadata schema, thread depth, production models + cost ceiling.
Defaults: non-support = label only (no reply); escalation = label + Gmail notification.

## Retry policy
OpenAI + Pinecone HTTP nodes: 3 tries, 3s wait, then the error output routes to 14 - Human Escalation.
Gmail Reply: NO retry (could double-send); failure escalates.
Idempotency state lives in workflow static data (active executions only).
